name: s17-mine-star-op0-p0
cmd: set -o pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && grep -m1 'model name' /proc/cpuinfo && mkdir -p s17 && cp s17data/family.json s17/family.json && (cd . && mkdir -p prof && GDP_COUNTS_TRACE=3 GDP_COUNTS_DUMP_ALL_PASSES=1 timeout -s TERM -k 10 300 bun --cpu-prof --cpu-prof-md --cpu-prof-dir=prof --cpu-prof-interval=4000 research/track-wall/s17-trace.ts s17/family.json star 0 0 60000 > trace.out 2> trace.err; echo EXIT $?; echo EVENTS $(grep -c '^S17 ' trace.out); grep 'S17_END' trace.out | cut -c1-600; grep 'counts: try' trace.err | cut -c1-300; echo HEAD; grep '^S17 ' trace.out | head -12 | cut -c1-700; echo TAIL; grep '^S17 ' trace.out | tail -25 | cut -c1-700; echo PHASES; grep '^S17 ' trace.out | grep -o '"phase":"[^"]*"' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -20; echo ERRORS; grep '^S17 ' trace.out | grep -o '"error":"[^"]*"' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -12 | cut -c1-400; echo PROFILE; f=$(ls prof/*.md 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$f" ] && head -c 5000 "$f")
